gate_definition: Every individual scalar comparison must meet its fixed absolute bound. All comparisons must be finite. No relative-error fallback, percentile allowance, exclusion of poor rows or adaptive tolerance exists.

SI_basis.temperature_K: Retains the frozen source-field transfer target. Every active source-ID value is checked against the separately accepted original thermal BEGIN/END sample; this is not a physical thermometry accuracy claim.
SI_basis.displacement_m: Retains the proposed fixed SI support/current-restore target. Zero constraints and each retained previous-END value are tested directly in metres, with no millimetre conversion in code.
SI_basis.QP_coordinate_m: Predeclared solely for the irrational 1/sqrt(3) physical Gauss-point coordinates on exactly binary Cartesian edges of length 0.125/0.25/0.25 m. This is much smaller than any cell dimension and permits one unique physical point only. Mesh-node/source/sampler coordinate words remain exact binary64 comparisons.
SI_basis.strain: The nondimensional proposed source target is applied to Q1 symmetric gradients, all elastic/mechanical/total/eigenstrain components and increments. Ordered native connectivity must define a positive affine Cartesian HEX8; no geometric approximation, B-bar adjustment or tensor interpolation substitutes for that check.
SI_basis.stress_Pa: Retains the proposed 0.1 Pa absolute target, independently applied to the three-dimensional isotropic Hooke reconstruction with E=71e9Pa and nu=.33. Shear entries are tensor shear, not engineering gamma; symmetry supplies the other three entries. A strain comparison alone cannot substitute for the stricter stress comparison.
SI_basis.force_N: Retains the proposed 1e-7 N absolute target. Internal nodal forces are the eight-point integral of sigma_ij*dNa/dxj*dV, using m,Pa,m^3. Both reconstructed/native-QP force agreement and every combined free DOF are tested. Constrained reactions, total nodal force and constrained-only resultant are checked independently. No serial-bar force or mm/MPa formula is reused.
SI_basis.moment_Nm: Retains the proposed 1e-7 N*m absolute target for the explicit SI coupon about its source origin. Uses observed source coordinates and nodal reaction forces, both all-node and constrained-only resultants. It is a numerical balance test, not an engine attachment/load-path allowance.

reference_definition.weak_form: All active cells, including initially old cells, assembled before free/constrained residual decisions; a born/old shared interface is not independently traction-free.
